name: hud_ui_net_game_setup_panel_destructor
description: HudUiNetGameSetupPanel::Destructor releases multiplayer setup child widgets in the Binary Ninja order, then destroys the HudUiBackground base.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The smoke patches child/base destructors to record call targets and ordering without executing nested cleanup.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41a400 validates reverse child destruction: lapsSwitch, killsSwitch, nameTagsToggle, allowMapsToggle, max-player step buttons/input, kills step buttons/input, time-limit step buttons/input, world buttons/selector, game-name input, cancel/play buttons, then HudUiBackground::Destructor.
The native smoke verifies the destructor dispatch target, object pointer, and order for all 20 destructor calls.
